name: Tax Account Number (TAN)
note: Mauritius's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: the TIN is officially the Tax Account Number (TAN); the Mauritius Revenue Authority issues one to every individual with a tax obligation, at the individual's registration in its databases, not automatically to all residents; eight numerals, an individual's starting with 1, 5, 7 or 8. Read as given on registration, to anyone with a tax obligation. No check rule, age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Mauritius: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: In Mauritius the TIN is officially called the Tax Account Number (TAN). For individuals: The Mauritius Revenue Authority (MRA) issues a Tax Account Number to all individuals with a tax obligation in Mauritius. The TAN is given at the time of the registration of the individual in the databases of the MRA. ... For individuals: The TAN consists of 8 numerals (format: 99999999). The first digit of the TAN is always 1, 5, 7or 8.
